- nda-11: No reverse engineering — The document does not mention reverse engineering anywhere. Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-16: Return of confidential information — Segment [39] says all Information shall upon request be returned or destroyed. This is upon request of the Disclosing Party, not upon termination. The hypothesis says "upon the termination of Agreement." The document says "upon respective request of the Disclosing Party." Hmm — typically in these NDA tasks, this is considered Entailment with evidence [39], [40]. The return/destruction obligation exists. Label: Entailment, evidence [39, 40].
- nda-15: No licensing — Segment [43]: "No license is hereby granted..." Also [42] disclosure shall not confer any rights. Label: Entailment, evidence [42, 43].
- nda-10: Confidentiality of Agreement — Not mentioned. Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-2: None-inclusion of non-technical information — Segment [25] says "including but not limited to technical documentation, analyses, studies, knowledge and samples" — "including but not limited to" means it's not only technical. So the hypothesis "Confidential Information shall only include technical information" is Contradiction. Evidence [25].
- nda-1: Explicit identification — No requirement that info be expressly identified/marked. Not mentioned. Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-19: Survival of obligations — Segment [47]: obligations survive termination for two years. Label: Entailment, evidence [47].
- nda-12: Permissible development of similar information — Segment [29]: independently developed by Receiving Party is excluded from Information. Label: Entailment, evidence [29].
- nda-20: Permissible post-agreement possession — No mention of retention after return/destruction. Actually [30] says info required to be retained by law is excluded. Hmm, that could support retention. But typically labeled NotMentioned. Segment [30] excludes info "required to be disclosed, retained or maintained by law" from the definition of Information — this means such info isn't Confidential Information, not that they may retain Confidential Information. Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-3: Inclusion of verbally conveyed information — No mention of oral/verbal information. Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-18: No solicitation — Not mentioned. Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-7: Sharing with third-parties — Segment [34] allows sharing with advisers, subsidiaries, affiliates who need to know. Advisers are third parties. Label: Entailment, evidence [34].
- nda-17: Permissible copy — Segment [36] says "nor make any copies of it or reproduce it in any form" — this prohibits copies. So hypothesis "may create a copy in some circumstances" is Contradiction. Evidence [36].
- nda-8: Notice on compelled disclosure — Not mentioned (segment [30] excludes legally required disclosure but no notice obligation). Label: NotMentioned.
- nda-13: Permissible acquirement of similar information — Segment [28]: info available from a source other than Disclosing Party not bound by confidentiality is excluded. Label: Entailment, evidence [28].
- nda-5: Sharing with employees — Segment [34]: may make available to employees who need to know. Label: Entailment, evidence [34].
- nda-4: Limited use — Segment [35]: use only for Business Purpose unless prior written consent. Label: Entailment, evidence [35].
